text.autoconfig.clearsight.title: Clear Sight Configuration
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.disabl: Removes the Warden darkness: fog and screen dimming.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hideEf: Hides your own potion particles. Effects still work.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.clearP: See while stuck in powder snow.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.fireOv: 100 = vanilla, 0 = hidden, in between shifts the flames down.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hideTo: Skips the full-screen totem pop-up and your own burst.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hideHu: The screen no longer tilts when you take damage.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hideMa: Removes worn-equipment overlays like the pumpkin blur.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hideFr: Removes the creeping frost edge from powder snow.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hidePo: Removes the purple swirl and the screen warp inside nether portals.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hideSp: Removes the black circle while scoping.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hideSl: Removes the black fade while lying in bed.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hideFi: Removes the rocket trail while boosting an elytra.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hideDe: Removes the F3+B arrows, keeps the boxes.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hideBo: The world stays bright during boss fights. The boss bar stays.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.menuIn: Removes the dark tint behind your inventory and creative mode.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.menuSt: Removes the tint behind chests, barrels, shulkers, hoppers and horses.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.menuWo: Removes the tint behind crafting, furnaces, anvil, enchanting and the rest.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.menuVi: Removes the tint behind the merchant trade screen.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.menuSi: Removes the tint behind sign editing, books and lecterns.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.menuOt: Removes the tint behind any other screen, including modded ones.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.showWe: Rain means faster bites, so the weather shows while your bobber is out.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hideWe: Hides the weather completely: rain, snow, splashes, drips and the gloom.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.menuPa: Removes the tint behind the Esc menu.
